newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras seen loading Iraqi oil on Dec 13-14.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras seen loading Iraqi oil on Dec 13-14.

text.p: A senior Turkish oil official said on Tuesday he expected Turkey's state-run refiner Tupras to start loading a tanker on December 13-14 with Iraqi oil being exported under the U.N. oil-for-food deal.
The official was speaking after Tupras said it had signed a contract with Iraq's state oil marketing organisation SOMO to buy 75,000 bpd of Iraqi oil.

"The accord was signed and it was sent to the U.N. According to the resolution the accord must be approved within 24 hours. The deal is expected to be approved today by the U.N.," the official told Reuters.
"Tupras has sent an oil tanker to Ceyhan for loading. It is now sailing in the Aegean. Loading is expected to start on December 13-14," he said.
The Turkish energy ministry said earlier it planned to hold a ceremony on December 16 to celebrate the recommencement of oil exports.
Another oil official said this may delay loading of the tanker with oil for Tupras. "Or the government may change the date of the ceremony," the official said.
The United Nations gave Iraq clearance on Monday to start resuming oil exports so that it could buy food, medicine and other humanitarian goods.
